headings.description: Used for massive, edge-to-edge text. High tension, extreme scale. Brings the architectural, brutalist-editorial feel.

body.description: Clean, highly legible for 'dig deeper' paragraphs and meta details. Generous line height (leading-relaxed).

typography.rules: H1 should be scaled massively (text-6xl to text-[8vw]). Use tracking-tighter for headings. Line breaking is intentional and part of the design—split phrases for graphic impact.

colors.description: Warm paper white background with ink black typography. The accent color (a muted burnt orange/vermilion) is used extremely sparingly—only for interactive states or a subtle highlight in the marquee.

visual_enhancers.texture: Apply a very subtle CSS/SVG grain overlay (opacity-30) fixed to the background to give it a physical 'paper' texture.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use hairline borders (border-black/10) to divide list items in the Proof section.
visual_enhancers.favicon: Create and serve an original SVG monogram logo mark as the site favicon.

layouts.general: Continuous vertical scroll, single column but heavily asymmetrical within its bounds. Content placed on a 12-column CSS grid where text blocks are offset. Generous whitespace (py-32, py-40).
layouts.hero: Minimum 90vh. Contains massive typography with line breaks. Signature on-load masked line-by-line reveal.
layouts.proof_section: List of work samples/proof points. Uses a simple, repeatable layout (e.g., 1px top border per item). Incorporates expandable (accordion-style) 'dig deeper' areas.
layouts.contact: Minimal footer area with a massive 'Contact' heading and one primary button that copies the email to the clipboard.
layouts.mobile: Strict 390px-first responsive logic. Stack elements cleanly, retain the typographic hierarchy but use clamp() or Tailwind responsive utilities to prevent horizontal overflow.

motion.lenis: MANDATORY. Implement @studio-freight/react-lenis for premium momentum scrolling. This is crucial for the 'bleibtgleich' feel.
motion.framer_motion: Used for the hero masked line-by-line text reveal (overflow-hidden wrapper with y-axis transform on the text), scroll reveals (fade up + slight y translate), and one subtle parallax moment (e.g., moving an abstract shape or text block slightly slower than the scroll).
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Very slow, smooth drift. Editorial style (e.g., uppercase, wide tracking) showing: 'TECHNICAL CALLS — STAKEHOLDER MEETINGS — OPS — MARKETING'.
motion.interactions: Smooth button hovers. Accordion expand/collapse for 'dig deeper'.

components_to_build.name: NoiseOverlay
components_to_build.instructions: A fixed, pointer-events-none div covering the viewport with a subtle SVG noise background.

components_to_build.name: Hero
components_to_build.instructions: Full height. Large text '[Your Name]' and role split across lines. Use Framer Motion for a masked reveal on load.

components_to_build.name: EditorialMarquee
components_to_build.instructions: Slow, editorial ticker traversing across the screen displaying the journalist's versatile range.

components_to_build.name: ProofSection
components_to_build.instructions: A mapped list of placeholder work samples. Use framer-motion expanding sections for the 'dig deeper' content. Do not use complex cards; use flat, clean layout separated by lines.

components_to_build.name: ContactFooter
components_to_build.instructions: Massive type and a copy-to-clipboard button (use navigator.clipboard.writeText) with a 'Copied!' toast feedback (use Sonner).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the ink black text on paper white passes APCA/WCAG. Accent color must maintain 4.5:1 on the background.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the marquee and scroll reveals.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize Lenis for smooth scrolling at the root. 2. Build the Hero with a masked text reveal. 3. Build the editorial Marquee showing the requested phases. 4. Build the Proof section with collapsible 'dig deeper' details. 5. Build the Contact section with a functional copy-email button (use Sonner for the toast). 6. Implement a subtle parallax element (using Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform). 7. Create an SVG monogram and set it as the favicon. 8. Provide a detailed README.md keeping the brief, plan, decision log, and plain-words explanations of what was done. Use Tailwind for all styling. Ensure data-testid on interactables. Do NOT add dummy photos; use the requested minimal text placeholders.
